project_type: Node/Express backend (ESM) + React/Vite frontend (SPA), connected via Axios
build_system: Backend: plain node (no bundler). Frontend: Vite. Backend has no compile step — errors surface at startup. Frontend build: `npm run build` in `frontend/`.
test_framework: None configured. Verification = backend starts cleanly (`node server.js`) + frontend builds cleanly (`npm run build`).
test_command: cd e:\election-portaltab\backend && node server.js (starts, check for import/syntax errors, then Ctrl+C)
verification_instructions: 1. Start backend: `cd e:\election-portaltab\backend && node server.js` — must log 'Server running on port 5000' and 'Connected to MongoDB' without errors. 2. Build frontend: `cd e:\election-portaltab\frontend && npm run build` — must complete with no errors.
environment_constraints: ESM throughout — all imports must use .js extensions. No new npm packages (neither backend nor frontend). Backend package.json has `"type":"module"`. Mongoose 9 — no deprecated `.save()` patterns on subdocs. Express 5 — async handler errors are auto-caught.
contribution_requirements: Keep all existing routes intact. The POST /api/votes/batch endpoint and all GET/DELETE cooldown endpoints in votes.js must not be removed. The 404 handler in server.js must remain the last route.
key_patterns: Auth middleware (`middleware/auth.js`) sets `req.user = { id, role }` from JWT. Admin check: `if (req.user.role !== 'admin') return res.status(403)`. Mongoose upsert pattern: `Model.findOneAndUpdate({_id:'key'}, {$set:{...}}, {upsert:true, new:true})`. Frontend API calls: `import api from '../../utils/api'` (or `'../utils/api'`), then `api.get('/path')` / `api.post('/path', body)` — baseURL is `/api` so paths are relative to that. UI components: `Button` (variants: primary/secondary/danger/success/ghost, accepts `icon` prop), `Card` (glass-panel wrapper). Lucide icons from `lucide-react`. Tailwind CSS utility classes with `glass-panel`, `glass-input`, `glass-button` custom classes.
directory_structure: e:\election-portaltab\backend\ — Express server (server.js, routes/, models/, middleware/). e:\election-portaltab\frontend\ — Vite+React SPA (src/components/, src/utils/, src/contexts/). e:\election-portaltab\.agents\tasks\ — planning artifacts (never committed).
